repository.note: Remote source base; new artifacts executed in an isolated directory. Existing dirty local checkout was not used or modified.

mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact identities for the seven-dimensional rational involutive graded Frobenius model at a=3,b=5, with symbolic Q[g] curve intersection; not a universal geometric source-existence assertion.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q; Q[g] for the curve calculation
mathematics.conventions: Basis 1,h,h^2,h^3,h^4,s,r; codimensions 0,1,2,3,4,2,2; integral h^4=1; s^2=3h^4; r^2=5h^4; g(r)=-r; signed Euler kernel=-r tensor r/5.
non_claims: No actual variety or canonical Chow comparison is modeled.
No counterexample to the Hodge conjecture.
No claim that all geometric GST source hypotheses hold in this model.
No universal algebraic-source existence theorem or Lean compilation.

checks: All 343 basis associativity triples; trilinearity gives associativity at a=3,b=5.
All 49 basis automorphism pairs; unit, graded multiplication, Frobenius determinant, inverse pairing.
All nontrivial even Hard Lefschetz maps, primitive kernel and Gram.
Invariant tensor dimensions, residual projector, complete one-leg annihilation and signed Euler index.
Formal degree tests e=1,2,3,7; uniform all-e statement proved separately in the derivation.
Separate Wolfram parameterized symbolic check; see recorded .wl and .wolfram.txt.
